reviews.name: KK98
reviews.body: I like these they feel hydrating and give a nice glow but not sure they made a huge difference to my skin.

reviews.name: Jayne81
reviews.body:
I love the fact that you get the liquid separate and they feel very nourishing and super hydrating. 
The tweezers make grabbing them easier but the pads are very thin so it’s easy to pick up multiple 
Will definitely repurchase them

reviews.name: Sue44
reviews.body: Skin feels lovely and moist after using , you put the sachet of collagen into the tub with the pads

reviews.name: NixB
reviews.body: You really can’t go wrong with anything from Medicube. I use this at night and my skin feels so refreshed evening in the morning.

reviews.name: Holly
reviews.body: Very different to what I’ve tried before, you have to add stuff in to them and I feel like they go to damp, will be sticking with the original ones.

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.body: Very good toner leaves your skin squeaky clean and ready for serums

reviews.name: Melissa
reviews.body: I've been using these for a few weeks, and my skin does look abit brighter, and more glowy. I've had 2 people mention how lovely my skin was looking, and 1 of those people was my other half, and he's not noticed the 2 new ear piercings I did a couple of dags ago, so I'm taking it as a huge compliment 😆

reviews.name: Becky
reviews.body: I’m love all things medicube and these are no exception. I use them a step before I do the mask of the same range and it makes my skin feel amazing. Another firm favourite now.
